Assumption: Windows 10/11 desktop environment supports Chromium/Node.js portable Electron package without requiring elevated administrative privileges
The host OS grants direct read and write access to the user music directory and attached USB/SD removable storage volumes
Audio files in the library are valid MP3 (ID3v2.3/ID3v2.4) and FLAC (Vorbis comments) files parseable and writable by standard audio tag libraries
Car head unit supports standard FAT32/exFAT USB storage with relative path M3U playlist format and ASCII/UTF-8 path encoding
The platform Web Audio/HTML5 Audio API supports device routing via setSinkId and multi-window rendering on Windows
End users can run portable unsigned Windows executables following provided SmartScreen warning instructions and SHA-256 checksum verification
